name: TorchLean $ENVIRON audit mismatch
description: A persisted differential mismatch in a promoted source; investigate before any operator eligibility change.
aplQuery:
['$DATASET']
| where competition == 'torchlean' and environ == '$ENVIRON'
| where source == 'torchlean-audit-worker' and event_type == 'audit_failed'
| project _time, severity, event_type, environ, source, host, audit_id, board, promotion_id, source_hash, attempt, seed, cases, mismatches, reason

name: TorchLean $ENVIRON operational errors
description: Worker/startup/infrastructure errors or unexpected ERROR logs.
aplQuery:
['$DATASET']
| where competition == 'torchlean' and environ == '$ENVIRON'
| where severity in ('error', 'critical') and event_type != 'audit_failed'
| summarize errors=count() by source, host

name: TorchLean $ENVIRON audit backlog
description: Old pending/retrying audits, including tasks requiring another pinned release.
aplQuery:
['$DATASET']
| where competition == 'torchlean' and environ == '$ENVIRON'
| where event_type == 'audit_waiting'
| summarize waiting=count() by host

name: TorchLean $ENVIRON auditor heartbeat ($AUDIT_HOST)
description: Required auditor emitted no heartbeat for five minutes; also detects missing ingestion.
aplQuery:
['$DATASET']
| where competition == 'torchlean' and environ == '$ENVIRON'
| where source == 'torchlean-audit-worker' and host == '$AUDIT_HOST' and event_type == 'service_heartbeat'
| summarize heartbeats=count()
